scientific_boundaries.qualified_claim: Bounded three-seed progressive-learning retention for this expanded 5981-parameter neural ISA MLP plus learned zero predicate.
neural_components: operation meaning logits causally consumed by the bit MLP
scientific_boundaries.promotion: No champion/default promotion authorized or performed.

limitations: The NC005 model is an expanded MLP, not the selected RLT Transformer champion.
Five old operations were already fully pretrained.
All 64 local patterns for each operation appear in training.
Program selection, PC control, routing, flags, HALT and ROM remain host mechanisms.
Sequence and loop programs and their training traces are host supplied.
Source-pretraining overlap with evaluation operands is not disproven.
Matched graph-execution counts are not measured FLOPs or time.
The rehearsal and new_only arms intentionally have different example exposure.
The archived pilot and its 42 checkpoints are preliminary and unqualified.
Results cover three fixed seeds and declared bounded tests, not arbitrary programs or machine states.
